name: Create a two-column album poster with massive right-aligned title
query: Create a full-width album-release poster pattern with a small description and Shop Now button on the left, and a huge stacked album title and artist name right-aligned on the right.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-patterns and gather album title, artist, copy, CTA label, text domain, and theme presets
Step 2: Use a full-width color-field Cover or Group with a two-column flexible layout
Step 3: Put compact descriptive copy and CTA in a narrow left column
Step 4: Use massive stacked right-aligned display text in the larger column
Step 5: Use color contrast intentionally, with non-overlapping readable text
Step 6: Escape and translate all visible strings
Step 7: Verify responsive stacking and text fit
success_criteria: Creates asymmetry between compact copy and massive display title
Uses color contrast and alignment as deliberate design choices
Heading/text hierarchy remains understandable in source order
Uses block-native layout controls and theme presets where possible
No scripts, inline style tags, custom CSS classes, or runtime PHP
Verification includes mobile wrapping and contrast
